title: Ethical Concern Identification in NLP: A Corpus of ACL Anthology Ethics Statements
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on general ethical concerns in NLP papers, such as bias, misuse, privacy, and environmental impact.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The word 'religion' is mentioned only once in passing, suggesting that public existential concerns about AI could be linked to 'deep-rooted fears found in myth and religion', but this is presented as an avenue for future interpretation by other fields (like sociology or philosophy) and is not a finding of this study.
references: ALLEA. 2017. The European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity. Technical report, ALLEA.
